faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: General answers regarding our notary and document services in Union City, NJ.

items.q: What Notary Public services do you offer in Union City, NJ?
items.a: We provide signature notarizations, certified copies, sworn affidavits, and mobile travel notary services throughout Union City and Hudson County, NJ.

items.q: What is a FOIA immigration-record request?
items.a: Need a copy of records an agency may hold about you? We help you prepare and submit a FOIA records request. This service is about requesting records; it is not a legal opinion, case strategy, or guarantee about what records show.

items.q: What is the difference between document preparation and legal advice?
items.a: Jaime's Help Club is not a law firm. We provide clerical document organization and typing assistance based on your directions. Only a licensed attorney can provide legal advice or case representation.

items.q: Do you travel for mobile notary appointments?
items.a: Yes, mobile appointments can be scheduled to meet at your home, workplace, or a convenient location within Union City and Hudson County.
We provide full bilingual assistance in both English and Spanish. Contact us in whichever language is most comfortable for you.

sections.p: The contact form asks for your name, phone number, requested service, general message, and optional email. After validation, the site prepares a WhatsApp message with those details for you to review. Please do not include passport numbers, A-numbers, or sensitive documents.

The site uses your details to prepare the message and does not send it automatically or store a copy in the application. If you choose to send it through WhatsApp, WhatsApp/Meta receives and processes it under its own privacy terms. The business does not sell your information.
You can review or edit the prepared message before sending it. For questions about information you have sent to the business, contact us using the phone or WhatsApp details on this site.
All content on this website is for general informational purposes. Jaime's Help Club is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice or attorney representation.
Official decisions regarding documents and filings rest exclusively with the relevant government agencies. No outcome guarantees are made.
If you have questions regarding these terms, contact us at 646-460-5360.
